age.label: Age
age.description: 0 = a young closed cap, 1 = an old cap that has turned to ink. Every mushroom of the cluster gets its own from the time

length_young.label: Length, young
length_young.description: The stipe of a primordium that has just come out of the common base

room.label: Room
room.description: How far apart the tips of grown stipes keep, less than the radius of a cap, so the caps overlap like shingles

points.label: Places
points.description: Where the stipes start, the places on the substrate. Without them the stipes stand where the template puts them

lean.label: Lean
lean.description: How far the outermost stipes lean out of the tuft at their base before they turn up again

age.label: Age
age.description: 0 = a young closed cap, 1 = an old cap that has turned to ink. Every mushroom of the cluster gets its own from the time

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Radius of the drawn bell when it has opened. The young cap is a little smaller and closes around the stipe into a tall cylinder, the old one melts away from the margin

t.label: Time
t.description: The gills go from white over cream to a spotted pale brown with the time

age.description: 0 = a young closed cap, 1 = an old cap that has turned to ink. Every mushroom of the cluster gets its own from the time

height_young.label: Height, young
height_young.description: Where the ring sits on a young stipe, as a share of it from its base: just under the closed cap

height_old.label: Height, old
height_old.description: Where the ring sits on an old stipe, high up, under the cap

length.label: Width
length.description: How far the cottony ring stands out from the stipe

spacing.label: Scale spacing
spacing.description: How far apart the scales are. 0 leaves the cap smooth

color_centre.label: Color, centre
color_centre.description: The middle of the cap, darker

color_base.label: Color, stipe base
color_base.description: The lower part of the stipe, darker towards its base
